gloss: consultation office; advice center; counseling center

definitions.gloss: consultation office; counseling center; advice bureau
definitions.explanation: An office or center providing guidance, consultation, or advice on a specific topic. Common types include legal advice centers, child welfare consultation offices, marriage consultation agencies, and medical advisory services.

examples.japanese: ⟦{弁護士|べんごし}→弁護士：03150_bengoshi⟧{相談所|そうだんじょ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{電話|でんわ}した→電話する：05652_denwasuru⟧。
examples.english: I called a legal consultation center.

examples.japanese: ⟦{結婚|けっこん}→結婚：02514_kekkon⟧{相談所|そうだんじょ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{登録|とうろく}して→登録する：25227_tourokusuru⟧⟦{婚活|こんかつ}→婚活：05833_konkatsu⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{始|はじ}めた→始める：00531_hajimeru⟧。
examples.english: I registered with a marriage consultation agency and started looking for a partner.

examples.japanese: {子|こ}ども⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{悩|なや}み→悩み：06650_nayami⟧⟦について→〜について：03103_nitsuite⟧{児童|じどう}{相談所|そうだんじょ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{相談|そうだん}→相談：02089_soudan⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}った→行く：00119_iku⟧。
examples.english: I went to a child welfare consultation center for advice about my child's concerns.

notes:
Compound of ⟦{相談|そうだん}→相談：02089_soudan⟧ (consultation, advice) + {所|じょ} (place). Appears as part of many compound nouns specifying the type of consultation.

COMMON COMPOUND TYPES:
- ⟦{結婚|けっこん}→結婚：02514_kekkon⟧{相談所|そうだんじょ}: marriage consultation agency
- ⟦{法律|ほうりつ}→法律：01722_houritsu⟧/⟦{弁護士|べんごし}→弁護士：03150_bengoshi⟧{相談所|そうだんじょ}: legal advice center
- {児童|じどう}{相談所|そうだんじょ}: child welfare consultation office
- {消費生活|しょうひせいかつ}{相談所|そうだんじょ}: consumer affairs consultation center

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{相談室|そうだんしつ}→相談室：25064_soudanshitsu⟧: counseling room — an individual room rather than an organization
- ⟦{窓口|まどぐち}→窓口：03154_madoguchi⟧: service counter, point of contact — a broader term for any service or inquiry desk
